items.one_liner: LovelyCarve is a fast, Rust-based desktop forensic suite featuring read-only container decryption and built-in timeline carving.
items.summary: LovelyCarve is an open-source, desktop disk forensics and data recovery tool built using Rust, Tauri 2, and Vue 3, tailored for digital forensics, incident response, and CTF investigations. It treats forensic evidence strictly as read-only, implementing native Rust readers for disk images, logical evidence, file systems, and encrypted containers like BitLocker, LUKS, and VeraCrypt without generating unencrypted plain-text copies. The application includes robust features such as case management with hash audits, file browsing, multi-format previewing, global regex searching, timeline generation, file carving across 14 formats, and C ABI-based plugin analysis.
key_facts: Supported formats: GPT, MBR, LVM2, BitLocker, LUKS, VeraCrypt, FileVault 2
items.bottom_line: LovelyCarve offers a memory-safe, Rust-powered desktop application for forensic disk analysis, file carving, and evidence auditing.

items.title: Why Keralam has launched India’s first ecosystem Red List assessment
items.one_liner: Kerala launched India's first state-level ecosystem Red List assessment to tackle severe habitat degradation and climate risks.
items.summary: Kerala's tropical riparian evergreen forests in the southern Western Ghats have experienced an 83% decline over the past century due to dam construction, invasive plantations, and climate extremes, placing them under Critically Endangered status according to IUCN criteria. To address this environmental crisis, the Kerala State Biodiversity Board (KSBB) launched India's first state-level Red List Assessment of Ecosystems (RLE) project. Jointly executed by the Kerala Forest Research Institute and MES Asmabi College, the one-year project systematically evaluates ecosystem collapse risks across all 14 districts. The initiative will produce an official Risk Register, an Ecosystem Typology Atlas, and ecorestoration priority maps to guide grassroots biodiversity management committees in climate adaptation.
key_facts: Target area: All 14 districts of Kerala
items.bottom_line: Kerala is pioneering landscape-wide ecosystem risk assessments to drive grassroots climate adaptation and habitat restoration across its 14 districts.
